opening.argument: The presentation promotes liquidity provision, lending, and investor participation through unusually high-return claims. It describes a pool fluctuating from 280% to 500%, presents earnings as an “infinite return,” and calls a 100% return “free money zero risk.” It links supplying liquidity or crypto assets to fees and interest, while a visible interface displays APR, supplied liquidity, and rewards. The description invites viewers into a DeFi passive-income investor group and opens enrollment for guided portfolio assistance, alongside an affiliate earning claim. Warnings that returns are not guaranteed and that viewers could lose money qualify the pitch but do not undo its high-return promotion or invitations to participate.
